data.title: Consumer Reports cautions using AI chatbots for health inquiries
data.description: As time goes on, more people are turning to ChatGPT and other artificial intelligence tools for health questions. However, as Consumer Reports explains, they are not always accurate or reliable.
data.author: Tom Garris
